mentions.name: Customized Story Writing Service
mentions.description: This service turns people's personal events into customized stories or personalized messages: the writer asks questions, listens to the events the client shares, and crafts them into a written story or message. It is in an early phase and currently offered free of cost.
mentions.source_excerpt:
In mean time I have started writing customized story for people.
Where I ask some question, let them tell about events, and I turn it into a good story, or personalized message, if anyone here wants to try, do let me know.
Still in early phase so free of cost, let's see how it goes.
